text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, curving around the 4th corner. It's 
the final straight—!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*! ...Ha, haha, hahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so light... My legs feel so light...! 
Thank you, Victoire Pisa...!"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Now, from here on—let's go!

text_block_list.name: Pisa & Rose
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!!!! Haaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The sky is so vast today, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My legs even felt light. —No, it's that I 
had been wearing weights until yesterday. 
I finally realized it. ...Thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
………… Ah, that's right. You were worried 
about me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still inexperienced. I don't have 
what it takes to run on my own yet."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I realized this during the debut 
race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“—Regarding the joint training, I'd like 
to hear more about it once more.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...! Hehe, yes, by all means...♪

"An Exceptionally High-Level Debut Race"— 
Accompanied by this small headline, the 
debut race for the two came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Joint training?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We are peers running in the very same era. 
Shouldn't we make meaningful use of this 
bond?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't that right, Pisa?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe that if we connect, gather, 
and inspire one another, we can become 
much, much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Not just in body, but in spirit too. Shall 
we all move forward toward the future 
together?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Heeh, I'm surprised. To think Rose 
would make a proposal too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Either way, it's not a bad deal for me. I 
saw your debut race. I have a hunch the 
synergy with you two will turn into a 
powerful buff.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I would like to participate as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"That was a fantastic race from both of 
you. I believe there is a great deal to be 
gained from joint training sessions."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Alright, that settles it.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! I'm so glad. Truly, so very 
happy...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together from now on. I 
look forward to working with you♪

A few days after her debut race. I 
received word that she had begun joint 
training, along with a consultation 
request from her.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"For my Classic Year, I would like to 
challenge the Triple Crown route. ...What 
are your thoughts?"
choice_data_list:
I see, so you’re going for the Triple 
Crown route, huh?

text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Crown route is a path aimed at 
three Classic-class GⅠs: the Satsuki Sho, 
the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho."

Winning these races is a tremendous 
achievement; for example, winning just the 
Satsuki Sho alone earns one the 
prestigious title of "Satsuki Sho 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown road is hailed as the 
royal road, a path that commands an 
immense amount of attention.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, this is the path your peers 
will be challenging.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Looking toward the same goal, chasing 
victory side by side. Doing so... should 
make our bond even stronger.

Indeed, a relationship where you push each 
other higher as "rivals" will only make 
your bond stronger.
choice_data_list:
Got it. Let's go for the Triple Crown 
route.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! I'll do my very best.

"Even so, I'd like to fit in one race 
before her debut in the Satsuki Sho. For 
example, that grand stage in December—"
choice_data_list: How about the Hopeful Stakes, I wonder?

text_block_list.text:
A 2000m turf GⅠ race that serves as the 
championship decider for Junior Class 
middle distance, known as the gateway to 
the Classic campaign.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Understood, the Hopeful Stakes it is♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hope... That's a lovely name too. Heheh, I 
have to do my best.

A fine start. First, I'd like to prepare 
thoroughly for the next race, the Hopeful 
Stakes.
